title: Eleven Centuries of the Oracle
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Classify fourteen dated events from c. 750 BCE to 391-392 CE as signs of the Oracle of Delphi's strength or of its weakness and decline. Each answered card drops onto a timeline of the oracle's 1,140-year life, and a final question asks when the signs of decline begin to cluster.

educational.topic: The rise, peak, decline and end of the Oracle of Delphi
learningObjectives: Distinguish events that show the Oracle of Delphi's strength from events that show a weakness or decline, classifying at least 12 of 14 dated events correctly on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The Temple of Apollo at Delphi
The Amphictyonic League and the Sacred Wars
Decline and closing of the oracle

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classification with immediate feedback, then reveal on a shared timeline and a reflection question about the pattern
keyQuestions: Does this event show the oracle's strength, or a weakness?
After about what date do the signs of weakness cluster?
commonMisconceptions: The oracle declined suddenly when Christianity arrived.
Damage always means decline (the fire of 548 BCE led to a rebuilding paid for by the whole Greek world).
Corruption only appears late (the Alcmaeonid bribery happened at the oracle's height).
A late event must be a sign of decline (the defeat of the Gauls in 279 BCE added to the oracle's prestige).
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score on fourteen cards (mastery: 12 of 14, with two of the three trap cards correct).
Final reflection question on when the signs of weakness cluster (not scored).
